# Avatar

A person's photo or initials next to their name.

- Status: implemented
- Category: data
- Pattern: HTML `<img alt=""> or initials, decorative beside the name`
- Text style: `label` (`.nd-text-label`)

## Anatomy

- **container**: A circle in avatar.fill with a subtle edge; holds the photo or the initials.
- **image** (optional): The photo.
- **initials** (optional): When there is no photo.

## Variants

- `sm`: 2 rem
- `md`: 3 rem
- `lg`: 4.5 rem

## States

- `default`

## Accessibility

- Role: img or none
- Name: Empty alt when the name is beside it.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.1.1 Non-text Content (A)

## Contrast

Each pair meets its ratio in every theme and direction (checked on every build).

| Foreground | Background | Minimum |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `avatar.text` | `avatar.fill` | 4.5:1 |

  <span class="nd-avatar" aria-hidden="true">CD</span>
